Expectation: $\E{X+Y}$.

Sequence: $\Xin$.

Subscripted vector (a LaTeX error here fails the check): $\vxi^T$.

Indexed and squared vectors: $\vecf{x}_i$, $\vecf{X}_{ij}$, $\vecf{y}_i^2$.

Deviation and estimation error, squared and with a compound reference: $\devof{\frac{a}{b}}{\paren{\mu_1 + \mu_2}}^2$, $\esterr{\predval}{\Outvar}^2$.

Subscripted and squared deviations: $\devof{\frac{a}{b}}{\paren{\mu_1 + \mu_2}}_i$, $\esterr{\frac{a}{b}}{\theta}_i^2$, $\esterr{\predval}{\Outvar}_i$.

Noise: $\Noise_i^2$, $\noise_i^2$, $\vNoise_i^2$, $\vnoise_i^2$, $\vNoise^T$.

Residuals, prediction errors and the deviation from a mean, subscripted and squared: $\resid_i^2$, $\Resid_i$, $\stdresid_i^2$, $\modresid_i^2$, $\vresid_i^T$, $\residv^T$, $\prederr_i^2$, $\prederrf{g}_i^2$, $\vprederr_i^T$, $\popdev_i^2$, $\cdev_i$.

Design matrix, design vector and feature map, subscripted and squared: $\design_{ij}^2$, $\vdesign_i^2$, $\vdesign^T$, $\vfeatmap_i^2$, $\featmap^2$.

Largest and smallest eigenvalues, subscripted and squared, and the call forms with a tall argument: $\eigvalmax^2$, $\eigvalmin_i^2$, $\eigvalmaxf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\eigvalminf{\stprod{\design} / \nobs}^{-1}$.

Deviances, subscripted and squared: $\deviance_i^2$, $\deviance^2$, $\nulldeviance$, $\satdeviance^2$, $\dicdev^2$, $\dicdevf{\vth}^2$.

Degrees of freedom and regression coefficients, subscripted and squared: $\df_i^2$, $\hdf_i^2$, $\edf^2$, $\Regcoef_i^2$, $\Coef{j}^2$.

Equality with a reason, alone, with a tall side, and squared: $a \eqby{\text{(A1)}} b$, $\frac{a}{b} \eqby{\text{Thm 2}} c$, $\paren{a \eqby{\text{(A1)}} b}^2$, $\E{X \eqby{\text{(A1)}} Y}^2$.

Input counts, subscripted and squared: $\ninputvars_i^2$, $\inputdim^2$.

Sum of the elements, plain, squared and with a tall argument: $\sumof{\vy}$, $\Sumof{\vY}^2$, $\Sumof{\frac{a}{b}}_i$.

Fitted prediction function, plain, squared and applied: $\epredfn^2$, $\epredfnf{x}^2$, $\predfnf{x}_i$, $\bestpredfnf{x}^2$.

Sample means, plain, subscripted and squared: $\smean{y}_i^2$, $\xbar^2$, $\samplemean{X}{n}^2$, $\smeandev^2$, $\smeandev_i$, $\avgleverage^2$.

Sums of squares, squared and subscripted: $\RSS^2$, $\RSS_0$, $\TSS_i$. Training symbols: $\nnetparams^2$, $\iter_i$, $\layeridx^2$, $\objfn_i$, $\objfnf{\vth}^2$.

Confidence interval endpoints, plain, subscripted, squared and with a tall argument: $\cilo^2$, $\ciup_i$, $\cilof{x}^2$, $\ciupf{x}_i$, $\cintf{X}^2$, $\cintf{\frac{a}{b}}_i$, $\Prunder{\theta}{\theta \in \cintf{X}} \ge 1 - \alpha$.

Probability under a parameter, plain, squared, subscripted and with a tall argument: $\Prunder{\theta}{A}$, $\Prunder{\theta}{A}^2$, $\Prunder{\theta}{A}_i$, $\Prunder{\frac{a}{b}}{\frac{c}{d} \in \cintf{X}}^2$.

Residual variance and its deprecated alias: $\resvar$, $\irrerr$, $\paren{\resvar}^2$.

Partial derivative with a slash, with a compound numerator, subscripted and squared: $\derivfslash{f}{x}$, $\derivfslash{\paren{n \bar{y}}}{\beta_0}$, $\derivfslash{\frac{a}{b}}{\theta}^2$, $\derivfslash{f}{x}_i$, $\paren{\derivfslash{f}{x}}^2$, $\paren{\derivfslash{f}{x}}_i$.

Step length and iterate, plain, squared and with a tall argument: $\steplen$, $\steplen^2$, $\iterpoint{\vx}{\iter}$, $\iterpoint{\vx}{\iter + 1}$, $\iterpoint{\steplen}{\iter}$, $\iterpoint{\vx}{\iter}^2$, $\iterpoint{\E{\frac{a}{b}}}{\iter}^2$.
